risks: Accidental conversion of REVIEW into a generic model-controlled retry loop

Turning finding text into source authority

protected_acceptance_map.title: Exact REVIEW-only transition
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: An authenticated request with the exact current revision can transition a Project-bound run from REVIEW to PLAN. The same request is rejected from every other state and ordinary `resume()` behavior is unchanged.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Findings are bounded and acceptance-linked
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: The request rejects empty findings, unknown acceptance IDs, malformed nested data, duplicate exact findings, over-limit counts/text and any acceptance reference outside the immutable run acceptance map.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Same-run source continuity is exact
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: The transition requires the latest successful IMPLEMENT evidence and records its exact accepted source-lineage/workspace identity. The new PLAN resolves that same lineage as its base; no cross-run/default-branch source substitution is admitted.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Rework context has deterministic identity
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: Equivalent canonical findings produce the same bounded SHA-256 rework-context digest; changed finding text or affected acceptance IDs changes the digest. The latest PLAN persists and independently verifies the exact current digest.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Findings reach implementation generation safely
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: The rework IMPLEMENT request includes bounded server-owned correction guidance plus the unchanged approved contract and protected source context. Findings do not bypass typed generation, proposal safety, disposable validation, independent evaluation, SafeImplementationEngine or lineage acceptance.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Old selected candidate cannot replay
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: A prior `READY_FOR_INTEGRATION` worker/candidate artifact is reset through the explicit rework preparation path. The old plan/candidate checkpoint cannot satisfy `selected_candidate_artifact()` for replacement IMPLEMENT.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Worker re-arm is narrow and idempotent
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: The reset requires an unleased exact-run worker and exact reviewed accepted lineage, uses the existing RECOVERING/REASSIGNED lifecycle, is idempotent for an already-prepared matching rework, and rejects active leases, unrelated terminal states or lineage drift.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Interrupted rework request is replay-safe
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: If the run transition commits before worker preparation, repeating the same operation does not create another transition and successfully completes only the pending worker preparation when safe.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Fresh correction cycle uses latest evidence
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: After rework, PLAN/IMPLEMENT/BUILD/TEST/VERIFY use the new cycle's latest successful PLAN and accepted implementation lineage. Earlier passing attempts cannot authorize stale execution or REVIEW completion.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Static-web evidence truthfulness remains unchanged
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: Reworked static-web TEST/VERIFY still use P2-V0.23.40 `STRUCTURAL_ONLY` evidence with empty verified acceptance IDs and return to REVIEW rather than COMPLETE.

protected_acceptance_map.title: No material-scope bypass
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: The endpoint cannot amend the Work Specification or add acceptance criteria. Material objective changes continue to require the existing `SPEC_AMENDMENT`/draft/approval path.

protected_acceptance_map.title: No authority expansion
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: Diff and protected tests prove no new model/provider/credential/network/command/execution-profile/Git/Preview/merge/production/automatic-REVIEW authority and no cross-run source-lineage authority.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Protected release gates pass
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: Spec validation, authentic DSPy SpecCritic/SpecCompiler, strict compiled-plan validation, focused tests, full API regression, Bounded Autonomy, Workstream Spec Validation and P2 CI pass on exact reviewed heads.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Production runtime remains healthy
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: Exact merged API source reaches production READY; normal production preflights, `/health`, `/ready` and exact-deployment runtime scans pass.

protected_acceptance_map.title: W9-S1 real correction is proven
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: After deployment, the frozen Decision Ledger run accepts bounded REVIEW findings for the observed import-safety and automated-test defects, regenerates from its existing accepted candidate lineage through the protected path, reruns normal validation, and returns to human REVIEW. Any subsequent independent application defect is recorded separately rather than hidden.
